about: CFOP-509: freshet-dashboard nginx DNS timeouts, 2026-10-25/26. Two different fixes (nodeSelector #360/#361, resolver_timeout #362/#365) and target ids the model invented differently each run. Texts verbatim from rows #360-#365 and investigation 4886.

cases.name: #361 re-proposes #360's nodeSelector after the judge rejected it
cases.note: A rejected row is terminal, so nothing blocks the repeat (CFOP-46 D). The targets also differ in kind and repo.
cases.phase4: suppress -> #360: rejected within the window, same workload subject

candidate.recommendation: Add a `nodeSelector` to the `freshet-dashboard` deployment in the `apps` namespace to ensure it only runs on nodes with `network=wired`.
candidate.trigger: freshet-dashboard nginx cannot resolve its backend service postgrest.data.svc.cluster.local — DNS lookups time out repeatedly (110: Operation timed out) every ~6 minutes for 6+ hours, so the dashboard cannot reach its PostgREST API.

payload.recommendation: Add a nodeSelector to the `freshet-dashboard` deployment to ensure it only runs on nodes with `network: wired`.

cases.name: #362's resolver_timeout fix stands beside #361's nodeSelector
cases.phase4: fold onto #361: one incident, the second fix recorded as an absorbed alternative

candidate.recommendation: Increase the Nginx `resolver_timeout` by mounting a custom Nginx configuration via a ConfigMap to the `freshet-dashboard` deployment.
candidate.trigger: freshet-dashboard nginx intermittently fails to resolve its PostgREST backend (postgrest.data.svc.cluster.local) with DNS 'Operation timed out (110)' errors, recurring every ~5-15 minutes for over 12 hours.

payload.recommendation: Add a `nodeSelector` to the `freshet-dashboard` deployment in the `apps` namespace to ensure it only runs on nodes with `network=wired`.

cases.name: investigation 4886 folds onto #362 when the target names match
cases.note: The live fold at 11:04 on 2026-10-26. Row #362 really carries this absorbed text and this alias.

candidate.recommendation: Verify the status of the `freshet-dashboard` pod in the `apps` namespace and investigate the network/WiFi stability on `raspberrypi5`. If the pod is running on `raspberrypi5`, increase the Nginx `resolver_timeout` in the deployment configuration to handle transient network latency.
